summary: The PR addresses the issue of executing tearDown for skipped unittest.TestCase classes when running with --pdb. The change is minimal and appears to correctly handle the case.

issues.description: The addition of new test files is not part of the source change as per instructions, but the presence of these files in the diff is noted.
The new test files do not follow the naming convention used in the existing test files (e.g., they lack the 'test_' prefix in their names).
